 * '    __    __ __ __  __
 * '   / /   / //_// / / /
 * '  / /   / ,<  / /_/ /
 * ' / /___/ /| |/ __  /
 * '/_____/_/ |_/_/ /_/
 * '
 * Calls the Gemini Flashh 3.6 Model
 * @param {string} prompt The text prompt to send to the model.
 * @return {string} The text response generated by gemini flash model.
 */

/**
 * Call Gemini Flash model
 * the api key is stored under the google app script project settings - Script Properties
 * need to get the api key from https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys
 */

const API_KEY = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty("GEMINI_API_KEY");

function call_gemini(prompt) {
  const url =
    "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-3.6-flash:generateContent?key=" +
    API_KEY;
  const payload = {
    contents: [
      {
        parts: [
          {
            text: prompt
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  };

  var options = {
    method: "post",
    contentType: "application/json",
    payload: JSON.stringify(payload),
    muteHttpExceptions: true
  };

  var response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, options);

  var result = JSON.parse(response.getContentText());

  if (
    result.candidates &&
    result.candidates.length > 0
  ) {
    return result.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;
  }

  return JSON.stringify(result, null, 2);
}

/**
 * Quick manual test function.
 * Run this function in the Apps Script editor to check the logs.
 */
function test_gemini() {
  const prompt = "translate 日落西山你不陪,东山再起你是谁 to english";
  const result = call_gemini(prompt);
  Logger.log("Result:\n" + result);
}
